title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410M compute deal with Amazon
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Recursive’s emphasis on self-improving AI systems means much of the budget that would traditionally go toward headcount and operations is put straight into compute, as the company ...
body: In a landmark agreement, Recursive Superintelligence has secured $410 million in dedicated cloud compute resources from Amazon Web Services. The computing power will be directed toward training complex reinforcement learning algorithms that enable AI models to recursively self-improve. The partnership positions AWS as a major infrastructure provider for the startup's long-term research goals. This ensures stable access to dedicated training clusters, allowing researchers to run large-scale optimization experiments without compute interruptions. It highlights AWS's growing prominence in foundation model training.
